capabilities: Open the active note in DocWen
Export notes to Word, Excel or Markdown
Add or remove Markdown heading numbering
disambiguation: Not an AI writing assistant; it is a connection to the local DocWen desktop app.
extras: Desktop only (Windows/Linux); requires a separately installed local DocWen and does not download it; mobile Obsidian is unsupported.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to use DocWen's document conversion, proofreading and heading numbering from inside the app.

relations.evidence: The work is done by DocWen installed on your computer; this plugin is the connection between the two.

summary: Bridge to the local DocWen desktop app for exporting notes to Word, Excel or Markdown, proofreading in a sidebar, and numbering headings.
